missing_evidence: Postgres server-side connection/saturation metrics for the incident window
Order service connection pool configuration (max pool size, timeouts)
candidates.statement: Order service connection pool exhaustion: order traces show postgres.acquire_connection ERROR at 1650ms, order logs show 10 db_pool_acquire_timeout errors (503), and order metrics show db_pool_waiters=36 with p95 1300ms, propagating to gateway call-order ERROR at 1925ms.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record (order 3.1.5) does not establish causation; pool size/config and postgres-side saturation not observed.

report.explanation: Order service shows db pool waiters (36), acquire-connection timeouts and 503s, with gateway call-order errors and elevated latency; payment and inventory are healthy, so the fault is bounded to order's postgres connection pool. Deployment record alone does not establish causation.
